title: MediPulse Portal
subtitle: Multi-Tenant Healthcare & Pharmacy Management System
description: Developed a multi-tenant healthcare and pharmacy management platform using Next.js, React, and TypeScript, implementing multi-tenant routing, 8-tier RBAC, JWT authentication, and a 7-stage order lifecycle.
challenges: Handling multi-tenant clinical routing, strict role-based access control across 8 user tiers, and managing complex patient order state.
solutions: Designed multi-tenant routing architecture with Next.js 16 and Zustand. Integrated SurveyJS for dynamic medical questionnaires, TanStack Table for real-time order workflows, and maintained 480+ unit/integration tests using Vitest.

architectureSteps.title: Multi-Tenant Routing
architectureSteps.description: Next.js App Router isolates pharmacy and healthcare clinic tenant namespaces.

architectureSteps.title: 8-Tier RBAC & Auth
architectureSteps.description: JWT-secured middleware validates permission tokens across 8 healthcare roles.

architectureSteps.title: Clinical Surveys & Data Tables
architectureSteps.description: SurveyJS powers clinical intake forms while TanStack Table manages 7-stage order lifecycles.

architectureSteps.title: Automated Testing Suite
architectureSteps.description: Maintained 480+ unit and integration tests using Vitest to guarantee clinical compliance.

title: SolarShare
subtitle: P2P Solar Energy Trading Platform
description: Built a peer-to-peer solar energy trading platform with role-based workflows, dashboards, wallet/transactions, JWT authentication, and real-time updates using Socket.IO.
challenges: Delivering real-time bid-ask matching for renewable energy units without polling latency.
solutions: Implemented bi-directional WebSockets via Socket.IO for live order books and integrated secure wallet transaction ledgers with Mongoose schemas.

architectureSteps.title: Real-time WebSocket Feed
architectureSteps.description: Socket.IO synchronizes energy bid orders and price fluctuations in real time.

architectureSteps.title: Role-Based Workflows
architectureSteps.description: Custom dashboards for energy producers, consumers, and grid operators.

architectureSteps.title: Digital Energy Wallet
architectureSteps.description: JWT-secured transactions record energy credit transfers on MongoDB.

architectureSteps.title: Vite Client Interface
architectureSteps.description: Fast responsive Tailwind CSS interface designed for desktop and mobile trade.

title: EventElite
subtitle: Full-Stack Event Management Platform
description: Developed a full-stack event management platform with authentication, event creation, registrations, and user management.
challenges: Managing concurrent event registrations and preventing double-booking errors during high traffic periods.
solutions: Implemented transaction isolation levels in MySQL queries and optimized database connection pooling.

title: RentNest
subtitle: Airbnb-Inspired Rental Platform
description: Developed an Airbnb-inspired rental platform with authentication, property listings, bookings, and review management.
challenges: Developing a dynamic UI using EJS templates while handling complex nested documents for reviews and booking status states.
solutions: Designed modular mongoose schemas with subdocuments and pre-save hooks to automatically aggregate review ratings.
